purpose: Apply explicit MARKET_DATA_PROVIDER / FINANCIAL_MARKETS authority decisions to real Moomoo provider claims and admit them through the canonical Current Web Authority runtime without promoting W8E.
rules: Every claim sourceId must resolve to the governed provider-source handoff.
The provider source must be Moomoo OpenAPI and carry MARKET_DATA_PROVIDER authority class.
The registered provider must explicitly map to FINANCIAL_MARKETS.
Authority decisions are generated as explicit policy decisions only after source/provider identity checks pass.
GENERAL_CURRENT_FACT freshness is evaluated by the canonical CWA runtime at execution time.
Only DIRECT, admitted, non-conflicted selected provider evidence enters the provider RRE-eligible handoff.
Provider evidence is kept separate from the original W8C official/regulator batch until a later governed merge stage.
No provider admission may modify W8E semantic-basis supportState.
